'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are a basic resource, made from processing [[Log|logs]] at the [[sawhorse]] or [[circular saw]]. Alternatively, they can be purchased from [[Tress]] the wood merchant. They're used in the construction of a few basic workstations, as well as an intermediate step in crafting [[wood wedge]]s and [[firewood]].
